cat > /tmp/rewrite_views.rb << 'ENDSCRIPT'
#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

SKIP_TAGS = %w[script style svg kbd code pre textarea].freeze
VOID_TAGS = %w[area base br col embed hr img input link meta source track wbr].freeze
ATTRS = %w[aria-label aria-description title alt placeholder].freeze

def rewrite(source)
  tokens = tokenize(source)
  stack = []
  out = +""

  tokens.each do |kind, value|
    case kind
    when :text
      out << rewrite_text(value, stack)
    when :tag
      out << rewrite_tag(value, stack)
    when :erb
      out << rewrite_erb(value)
    else
      out << value
    end
  end
  out
end

def tokenize(source)
  tokens = []
  i = 0
  while i < source.length
    if source[i, 2] == "<%"
      close = source.index("%>", i + 2)
      raise "unterminated erb at #{i}" unless close
      tokens << [:erb, source[i..close + 1]]
      i = close + 2
    elsif source[i, 4] == "<!--"
      close = source.index("-->", i + 4)
      raise "unterminated comment at #{i}" unless close
      tokens << [:comment, source[i..close + 2]]
      i = close + 3
    elsif source[i] == "<"
      tag, next_i = read_tag(source, i)
      tokens << [:tag, tag]
      i = next_i
    else
      next_special = source.index("<", i) || source.length
      tokens << [:text, source[i...next_special]]
      i = next_special
    end
  end
  tokens
end

def read_tag(source, start)
  i = start + 1
  quote = nil
  while i < source.length
    if source[i, 2] == "<%"
      close = source.index("%>", i + 2)
      raise "unterminated erb in tag" unless close
      i = close + 2
      next
    end
    char = source[i]
    if quote
      quote = nil if char == quote
    elsif char == '"' || char == "'"
      quote = char
    elsif char == ">"
      return [source[start..i], i + 1]
    end
    i += 1
  end
  raise "unterminated tag at #{start}: #{source[start, 40]}"
end

def inside_skip?(stack)
  stack.any? { |tag| SKIP_TAGS.include?(tag) }
end

def rewrite_text(text, stack)
  return text if inside_skip?(stack)
  return text unless text.match?(/[A-Za-z]/)
  return text if text.include?("<%")

  leading = text[/\A\s*/]
  trailing = text[/\s*\z/]
  inner = text.strip
  return text if inner.empty?
  return text unless inner.match?(/[A-Za-z]{2,}/)
  # Don't translate lone entities or pure punctuation.
  return text if inner.gsub(/&[a-z]+;|&#\d+;/, "").strip !~ /[A-Za-z]{2,}/

  "#{leading}<%= Copy.html(#{inner.inspect}) %>#{trailing}"
end

def rewrite_tag(tag, stack)
  name = tag[/\A<\/?\s*([a-zA-Z0-9:-]+)/, 1].to_s.downcase
  closing = tag.start_with?("</")
  self_closing = tag.end_with?("/>") || VOID_TAGS.include?(name)

  unless closing || inside_skip?(stack)
    tag = rewrite_attributes(tag)
  end

  if closing
    stack.pop if stack.last == name
  elsif !self_closing && !name.empty?
    stack << name
  end
  tag
end

def rewrite_attributes(tag)
  tag.gsub(/\b(#{ATTRS.join("|")})\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/) do
    attr = $1
    value = $2
    if value.include?("<%") || value !~ /[A-Za-z]{2,}/
      $&
    else
      %(#{attr}="<%= Copy.html(#{value.inspect}) %>")
    end
  end
end

def rewrite_erb(erb)
  return erb if erb.start_with?("<%#")
  # Only rewrite output and code that assigns visible strings. Do this
  # conservatively inside the erb token.
  inner = erb
  inner = rewrite_page_titles(inner)
  inner = rewrite_helper_strings(inner)
  inner = rewrite_output_strings(inner)
  inner
end

def rewrite_page_titles(erb)
  erb.gsub(/@page_title\s*=\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"/) do
    raw = unescape($1)
    if raw.include?("\#{")
      "@page_title = #{interpolated_call(raw)}"
    else
      "@page_title = Copy.html(#{raw.inspect})"
    end
  end
end

def rewrite_helper_strings(erb)
  erb.gsub(/\b(link_to|button_to|button_tag|submit_tag|label_tag)\s+"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"/) do
    helper = $1
    raw = unescape($2)
    next $& unless ui_string?(raw)
    if raw.include?("\#{")
      "#{helper} #{interpolated_call(raw)}"
    else
      "#{helper} Copy.html(#{raw.inspect})"
    end
  end
end

def rewrite_output_strings(erb)
  # <%= "visible text" %> and <%= "text #{expr}" %>
  erb.gsub(/<%=\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"\s*%>/) do
    raw = unescape($1)
    next $& unless raw.match?(/[A-Za-z]{2,}/)
    if raw.include?("\#{")
      "<%= #{interpolated_call(raw)} %>"
    else
      "<%= Copy.html(#{raw.inspect}) %>"
    end
  end
end

def ui_string?(raw)
  return false unless raw.match?(/[A-Za-z]/)
  return false if raw.match?(/\A[a-z0-9_\-:.\/#]+\z/)
  true
end

def unescape(s)
  s.gsub(/\\"/, '"').gsub(/\\\\/, "\\")
end

def interpolated_call(raw)
  index = 0
  expressions = []
  template = raw.gsub(/#\{/) do
    # find matching brace from current position — handled below
    ""
  end
  # Manual scan so nested braces work.
  template = +""
  i = 0
  while i < raw.length
    if raw[i, 2] == "\#{"
      depth = 1
      j = i + 2
      while j < raw.length && depth.positive?
        depth += 1 if raw[j] == "{"
        depth -= 1 if raw[j] == "}"
        j += 1
      end
      expressions << raw[(i + 2)...(j - 1)]
      index += 1
      template << "%{value#{index}}"
      i = j
    else
      template << raw[i]
      i += 1
    end
  end
  args = expressions.each_with_index.map { |expr, idx| "value#{idx + 1}: (#{expr})" }.join(", ")
  "Copy.html(#{template.inspect}#{args.empty? ? "" : ", #{args}"})"
end

changed = 0
Dir["app/views/**/*.erb"].each do |path|
  original = File.read(path)
  updated = rewrite(original)
  next if updated == original
  File.write(path, updated)
  changed += 1
end

# Second pass: wrap remaining user-facing double-quoted strings in views.
SKIP_LINE = /class:\s*"|\bdata-action=|\bdata-controller=|\bstyle:\s*"|\bid:\s*"/

def ui_string?(s)
  return false if s.nil? || s.length < 2
  return false unless s.match?(/[A-Za-z]/)
  return false if s.include?("<%")
  return false if s.start_with?("--", "http", "/", "#", "var(")
  return false if s.include?("->")
  return false if s.match?(/[a-z0-9]+#[A-Za-z]/) # stimulus action
  return false if s.match?(/\A[a-z0-9_\-:.\/#@\[\]=%+\s]+\z/) # technical lowercase
  return false if s.match?(/\A[a-z]+[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*\z/) # camelCase identifier
  return false if s.match?(/\A[A-Z0-9_]{2,}\z/) # CONSTANT
  return false if s.include?("var(--")
  return false if s.match?(/\A#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\z/)
  return false if s.match?(/\A\d/)
  # CSS class-like: words of lowercase/hyphen
  return false if s.match?(/\A[a-z0-9_\-]+(\s+[a-z0-9_\-]+)*\z/)
  s.match?(/[A-Z]/) || s.match?(/[’“”…—!?]/) || s.include?(" ")
end

def interpolated_call(raw, method = "Copy.html")
  expressions = []
  template = +""
  i = 0
  while i < raw.length
    if raw[i, 2] == "\#{"
      depth = 1
      j = i + 2
      while j < raw.length && depth.positive?
        depth += 1 if raw[j] == "{"
        depth -= 1 if raw[j] == "}"

def rewrite_quoted(source, method = "Copy.html")
  source.gsub(/"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"/) do |match|
    raw = $1.gsub(/\\"/, '"').gsub(/\\\\/, "\\")
    # Don't rewrap arguments that are already Copy.html("...")
    # The regex doesn't see the method name; caller checks context via a scan.
    next match unless ui_string?(raw)
    if raw.include?("\#{")
      interpolated_call(raw, method)
    else
      "#{method}(#{raw.inspect})"
    end
  end
end

  original = File.read(path)
  updated = original.gsub(/"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"/) do |match|
    # If this quote is the argument of Copy.html( already, the preceding chars are Copy.html(
    # gsub doesn't give index easily. Use a manual scan instead.
    match
  end

  result = +""
  i = 0
  while i < original.length
    if original[i, 10] == "Copy.html(" || original[i, 7] == "Copy.t("
      # copy through the call's first string argument without rewriting it
      start = i
      # find the opening quote of the first arg
      j = original.index('"', i)
      if j.nil?
        result << original[i..]
        break
      end
      # include up to closing quote, handling escapes
      k = j + 1
      while k < original.length
        if original[k] == "\\"
          k += 2
          next
        end
        break if original[k] == '"'
        k += 1
      end
      result << original[start..k]
      i = k + 1
    elsif original[i] == '"'
      j = i + 1
      while j < original.length
        if original[j] == "\\"
          j += 2
          next
        end
        break if original[j] == '"'
        j += 1
      end
      literal = original[i..j]
      raw = literal[1..-2].to_s.gsub(/\\"/, '"').gsub(/\\\\/, "\\")
      if ui_string?(raw)
        result << (raw.include?("\#{") ? interpolated_call(raw) : "Copy.html(#{raw.inspect})")
      else
        result << literal
      end
      i = j + 1
    else
      result << original[i]

    end
  end

def ui_string?(s)
  return false if s.nil? || s.length < 2
  return false unless s.match?(/[A-Za-z]/)
  return false if s.start_with?("--", "http", "/", "#")
  return false if s.include?("->")
  return false if s.match?(/\A[a-z0-9_\-:.\/#@\[\]=%+]+\z/)
  return false if s.match?(/\A[A-Z0-9_]{2,}\z/)
  return false if s.match?(/\A[a-z]+[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*\z/)
  s.match?(/[A-Z]/) || s.match?(/[’“”…—!?]/) || (s.include?(" ") && s.match?(/[A-Za-z]{3,}/))
end

def wrap_file(path, method)
  original = File.read(path)
  return if original.include?("Copy.html") && original.include?("Copy.t") && false
  result = +""
  i = 0
  while i < original.length
    if original[i, 10] == "Copy.html(" || original[i, 7] == "Copy.t("
      j = original.index('"', i)
      k = j + 1
      while k < original.length
        if original[k] == "\\"
          k += 2
          next
        end
        break if original[k] == '"'
        k += 1
      end
      result << original[i..k]
      i = k + 1
    elsif original[i] == '"'
      j = i + 1
      while j < original.length
        if original[j] == "\\"
          j += 2
          next
        end
        break if original[j] == '"'
        j += 1
      end
      literal = original[i..j]
      raw = literal[1..-2].to_s.gsub('\\"', '"').gsub('\\\\', '\\')
      # don't wrap strings that contain interpolation; handle those manually
      if ui_string?(raw) && !raw.include?('#{')
        # don't wrap if this looks like a hash key used for logic: previous nonspace is not a colon-only
        result << "#{method}(#{raw.inspect})"
      else
        result << literal
      end
      i = j + 1
    elsif original[i] == "'"
      # skip single quoted
      j = i + 1
      while j < original.length
        if original[j] == "\\"
          j += 2
          next
        end
        break if original[j] == "'"
        j += 1
      end
      result << original[i..j]
      i = j + 1
    else
      result << original[i]
      i += 1
    end
  end
  if result != original
    File.write(path, result)
    true
  else
    false
  end
end

The `%()` string interpolation failed to translate `Copy.t("Done")` because it sat outside `#{}` braces. English output now shows the literal text `Copy.t("Done")` instead of `Done`. The bundle mailer subject was also corrupted by the wrapper. I will revert all Ruby file changes and apply them manually with much more care.

Additional models were affected: pushable, event description, filter fields and resources, time window parser, signup, and card. The card model wrapped class_name in translation. Helpers were also modified despite the script output not listing them.

A bulk replacement wrapper introduced serious bugs in SQL scopes, headers, class names, and string interpolations.

The safest fix is to revert all Ruby file changes from the bulk wrapper. Only intentional changes will be kept. User-facing strings will be fixed manually. Helpers, controllers, and mailers will be restored from git. The application mailer's from address needs manual correction.

The plan now includes models, event descriptions, filters, time window parser, signup logic, and notifications. View changes are mostly sound. The first step is to restore the broken Ruby files from git.

Authentication, application controller, and application mailer will be re-applied carefully. ruby << 'RUBY'
def extract(text)
  strings = []
  i = 0
  while i < text.length
    idx = text.index(/Copy\.(?:html|t)\(/, i)
    break unless idx
    j = idx + text[idx..].index("(")
    # skip whitespace
    j += 1
    j += 1 while text[j] =~ /\s/
    if text[j] == '"'
      k = j + 1
      raw = +""
      while k < text.length
        if text[k] == "\\"
          raw << text[k+1]
          k += 2
          next
        end
        break if text[k] == '"'
        raw << text[k]
        k += 1
      end
      strings << raw unless raw.length > 500
      i = k + 1
    elsif text[j, 3] == "%q{"
      k = j + 3
      depth = 1
      raw = +""
      while k < text.length && depth.positive?
        if text[k] == "{"
          depth += 1
        elsif text[k] == "}"
          depth -= 1
          break if depth.zero?
        end
        raw << text[k]
        k += 1
      end
      strings << raw unless raw.length > 500
      i = k + 1
    else
      i = j + 1
    end
  end
  strings
end

ruby << 'RUBY'
def extract(text)
  strings = []
  i = 0
  while (idx = text.index(/Copy\.(?:html|t)\(/, i))
    j = idx + text[idx..].index("(") + 1
    j += 1 while text[j] =~ /\s/
    if text[j] == '"'
      k = j + 1
      raw = +""
      while k < text.length
        if text[k] == "\\"
          raw << text[k+1].to_s
          k += 2
          next
        end
        break if text[k] == '"'
        raw << text[k]
        k += 1
      end
      strings << raw if raw.length < 400 && raw.match?(/[A-Za-z]/)
      i = k + 1
    elsif text[j, 3] == "%q{"
      depth = 1
      k = j + 3
      raw = +""
      while k < text.length && depth.positive?
        depth += 1 if text[k] == "{"
        depth -= 1 if text[k] == "}"
        break if depth.zero?
        raw << text[k]
        k += 1
      end
      strings << raw if raw.length < 400
      i = k + 1
    else
      i = j + 1
    end
  end
  strings
end
strings = []

strings.uniq!

puts strings.size

def unescape_ruby_string(body)
  body.gsub(/\\(.)/) do
    case $1
    when "n" then "\n"
    when "t" then "\t"
    when "r" then "\r"
    when '"' then '"'
    when "\\" then "\\"
    else $1
    end
  end
end

def extract(text)
  strings = []
  i = 0
  while (idx = text.index(/Copy\.(?:html|t)\(/, i))
    j = idx + text[idx..].index("(") + 1
    j += 1 while text[j] =~ /\s/
    if text[j] == '"'
      k = j + 1
      raw = +""
      while k < text.length
        if text[k] == "\\"
          raw << text[k, 2]
          k += 2
          next
        end
        break if text[k] == '"'
        raw << text[k]
        k += 1
      end
      strings << unescape_ruby_string(raw)
      i = k + 1
    elsif text[j, 3] == "%q{"
      depth = 1
      k = j + 3
      raw = +""
      while k < text.length && depth.positive?
        depth += 1 if text[k] == "{"
        depth -= 1 if text[k] == "}"
        break if depth.zero?
        raw << text[k]
        k += 1
      end
      strings << raw
      i = k + 1
    else
      i = j + 1
    end
  end
  strings
end

require "test_helper"

class LocaleTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as :kevin
  end

  test "japanese query param switches the page and sticks in the session" do
    get root_path(locale: "ja")
    assert_response :success
    assert_includes response.body, "ホーム"
    assert_equal "ja", session[:locale]

    get root_path
    assert_response :success
    assert_includes response.body, "ホーム"
    assert_select "html[lang=?]", "ja"
  end

  test "unknown locale does not break the page or switch language" do
    get root_path(locale: "xx")
    assert_response :success
    assert_not_includes response.body, "ホーム"
    assert_select "html[lang=?]", "en"
  end

  test "locale is restored the next time the person signs in" do
    identities(:kevin).update!(locale: "ja")

    delete session_path
    sign_in_as :kevin

    get root_path
    assert_response :success
    assert_includes response.body, "ホーム"
  end

  test "static error pages include both languages" do
    html = Rails.root.join("public/404.html").read
    assert_includes html, "Sorry, that page doesn’t exist!"
    assert_includes html, "申し訳ありません。そのページは存在しません。"
  end
end
EOF
